en-US.title: MirtPage
en-US.shortDescription: Explore business digital showrooms. Choose products and ask directly.
en-US.fullDescription:
MirtPage gives every business a professional digital showroom. Explore what it sells, makes or grows, with its brand, story, product range and listed availability in one organized place—without digging through social posts.

For customers
Explore retailers, workshops, factories, farms and suppliers. Search for products or find businesses on the map, with category, country and city filters. Open a showroom to browse photos, descriptions and the choices a business offers.

See listed availability and whether a product is ready to ship or made to order. Choose the items that interest you and send an inquiry through MirtPage Inbox. On a phone, you can also use WhatsApp or Telegram if the business lists them. On desktop, copy the prepared message and contact number to reach the business another way.

For businesses
Give what you sell, make or grow a showroom worth sharing. Bring your name, story and product range together, organize optional collections and share one link. Start with a private sample page, replace it with your own content and publish when ready. Customers explore your range and ask through MirtPage Inbox or a messaging channel you list.

Transport and Shipment records
Choose a logistics service provider and share the pickup and destination in chat. A live agent for the selected provider can discuss your shipment. If the team is busy, leave contact details for follow-up. Shipment records are separate from chat: verify your email with a code to see records shared with that address, the route stages entered for each shipment and any external provider tracking links.

Availability is information listed by each business. Confirm the product details and agree your order directly with that business. Shipment records organize entered route stages and optional provider links; they do not promise a live location or delivery date.

Use MirtPage in English, Amharic or Afaan Oromo.

am.title: MirtPage
am.shortDescription: የንግዱን ታሪክና ምርቶች በዲጂታል ማሳያው ይወቁ፤ ከንግዱም በቀጥታ ይጠይቁ።
am.fullDescription:
ለእያንዳንዱ ንግድ የተደራጀ ዲጂታል ማሳያ ገጽ። ንግዶች የሚሸጡትን፣ የሚሠሩትንና የሚያበቅሉትን ይመልከቱ። ምርቶቻቸውን፣ ስብስቦቻቸውን፣ አማራጮቻቸውንና ታሪካቸውን፣ ስለ ምርት አቅርቦት ካስቀመጡት መረጃ ጋር በአንድ ቦታ ያግኙ። የቆዩ የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ ልጥፎችን ሳይፈትሹ፣ የፈለጉትን መርጠው ንግዱን በቀጥታ ያነጋግሩ።

ለደንበኞች
ከሱቅና ከወርክሾፕ እስከ ፋብሪካ፣ እርሻና አቅራቢ፣ የተለያዩ ንግዶችን ያግኙ። ምርት ይፈልጉ፤ ንግዶችን በካርታ ይመልከቱ። በምድብ፣ በሀገርና በከተማ ያጣሩ። የንግዱን ማሳያ ከፍተው ፎቶዎችን፣ መግለጫዎችንና የቀረቡ ምርጫዎችን ይመልከቱ።

ምርቱ ለመላክ ዝግጁ መሆኑን ወይም በትዕዛዝ የሚሠራ መሆኑን ንግዱ ባስቀመጠው መረጃ ይወቁ። የሚፈልጉትን እቃ መርጠው ጥያቄዎን በMirtPage Inbox ለንግዱ ይላኩ። ንግዱ WhatsApp ወይም Telegram ካስቀመጠ፣ በስልክ እነዚያንም መጠቀም ይችላሉ። በኮምፒውተር የተዘጋጀውን መልዕክትና የመገናኛ ቁጥር መቅዳት ይችላሉ።

ለንግድ ባለቤቶች
የሚሸጡትን፣ የሚሠሩትን ወይም የሚያበቅሉትን በራስዎ ዲጂታል ማሳያ ያቅርቡ። ስምዎን፣ ታሪክዎንና ምርቶችዎን አንድ ላይ ያስቀምጡ፤ ከፈለጉ በስብስብ ያደራጁና አንድ ሊንክ ያጋሩ። በግል የምሳሌ ገጽ ይጀምሩ፤ በራስዎ መረጃ ተክተው ሲዘጋጁ ያሳትሙ። ደንበኞች ምርቶቹን አይተው በMirtPage Inbox ወይም እርስዎ ባስቀመጡት የመልዕክት መንገድ ይጠይቁዎታል።

ማጓጓዣና የጭነት መዝገቦች
የሎጂስቲክስ አገልግሎት አቅራቢ መርጠው መነሻና መድረሻውን በቻት ያሳውቁ። የመረጡት አቅራቢ የቀጥታ ወኪል ስለ ጭነቱ ከእርስዎ ጋር ይወያያል። ቡድኑ ስራ ላይ ከሆነ በኋላ እንዲያገኝዎ መገናኛዎን ይተዉ። የጭነት መዝገቦች ከቻት የተለዩ ናቸው፤ ኢሜይልዎን በኮድ አረጋግጠው ለእርስዎ የተጋሩ መዝገቦችን፣ የተመዘገቡ የመንገድ ደረጃዎችንና ካሉ የአጓጓዦች ሊንኮችን ይመልከቱ።

ስለምርት መገኘት መረጃውን የሚያስቀምጠው ንግዱ ነው። ዝርዝሩን ከንግዱ ያረጋግጡ፤ ትዕዛዙንም በቀጥታ በመነጋገር ያመቻቹ። የጭነት መዝገቦች የተመዘገቡ የመንገድ ደረጃዎችንና ካሉ የአጓጓዦች ሊንኮችን ያሳያሉ፤ ቀጥታ የጭነት ቦታን ወይም የመድረሻ ቀንን አያረጋግጡም።

MirtPageን በእንግሊዝኛ፣ በአማርኛ ወይም በአፋን ኦሮሞ ይጠቀሙ።

om.title: MirtPage
om.shortDescription: Daldalaa fi oomisha isaa bakka tokkotti ilaali; kallattiin gaafadhu.
om.fullDescription:
Daldala hundaaf fuula agarsiisa dijitaalaa sirnaan qophaa’e. Oomishaalee dhaabbileen daldalaa gurguran, hojjetan yookaan qonnaan oomishan ilaalaa. Oomishaalee, walitti qabama, filannoowwan fi seenaa isaanii, akkasumas odeeffannoo argamuu oomishaa isaan ibsan bakka tokkootti argadhaa. Maxxansa miidiyaa hawaasaa keessa osoo hin barbaadin, waan isin barbaachisu filadhaa; ergasii dhaabbaticha kallattiin quunnamaa.

Maamiltootaaf
Suqiiwwan, warshaalee xixiqqaa, warshaalee gurguddaa, qonnaan bultootaa fi dhiyeessitoota ilaali. Oomisha barbaadi ykn daldala kaartaa irratti argadhu. Gosa, biyya fi magaalaadhaan calali. Suuraa, ibsa fi filannoowwan daldalichi dhiyeessu bakka tokkotti ilaali.

Oomishni erguuf qophaa'aa ta'uu ykn ajaja irratti hojjetamuu isaa odeeffannoo daldalichi kaa'e irraa ilaali. Wantoota si barbaachisan filadhuutii gaaffii kee MirtPage Inbox irraa daldalichaaf ergi. Daldalichi WhatsApp yookaan Telegram yoo galche, bilbila irratti isaan fayyadamuu dandeessa; kompiitara irratti ergaa qophaaʼe fi lakkoofsa quunnamtii waraabi.

Abbootii daldalaaf
Waan gurgurtu, hojjettu ykn oomishtuu bakka agarsiisa dijitaalaa mataa keetii irratti dhiyeessi. Maqaa, seenaa fi oomishaalee kee walitti fidi. Yoo barbaadde tuuta tuutaan qindeessi; liinkii tokko qoodi. Fuula fakkeenyaa dhuunfaa irraa jalqabi; odeeffannoo mataa keetiin bakka buusiitii yeroo qophooftu maxxansi. Maamiltoonni oomishaalee kee ilaalanii MirtPage Inbox yookaan karaa ergaa ati galchiteen si gaafatu.

Geejjibaa fi Galmeewwan feʼumsaa
Dhaabbata tajaajila loojistikii filadhuutii bakka irraa fudhatamuu fi geeffamuu karaa chaatii himi. Hojjetaan dhaabbatichaa kallattiin waaʼee feʼumsichaa si waliin haasaʼa. Yoo hojjettoonni qabamanii jiran, akka si quunnamaniif lakkoofsa kee dhiisi. Galmeewwan feʼumsaa chaatii irraa adda: imeelii kee koodiin mirkaneessitee galmeewwan siif qoodaman, sadarkaalee imalaa galmaaʼan fi yoo jiraatan liinkiiwwan hordoffii dhaabbilee geejjibaa ilaali.

Odeeffannoo argama oomishaa kan kaa'u daldalicha. Ibsa isaa mirkaneeffadhu; ajaja kee daldalicha waliin kallattiin irratti walii gali. Galmeewwan feʼumsaa sadarkaalee imalaa galmaaʼan fi liinkiiwwan dhaabbilee geejjibaa yoo jiraatan agarsiisu; bakka feʼumsi yeroo ammaa jiru yookaan guyyaa gaʼumsaa hin mirkaneessan.

MirtPage Afaan Ingiliffaa, Amaariffaa fi Afaan Oromootiin fayyadami.

featureClaims.qualification: Business-listed information; customers confirm details directly.
External configured contact channels, prepared copy and manual copy; no customer-to-business inbox inside MirtPage.
Help by chat; no instant response, booking, price or delivery promise.
Email-code-authorized shipment tracking with staff-entered route stages and optional provider links; no GPS, scan event or delivery-completion claim.
